blurb: Golf Club of Jupiter features a golf course with events and tournaments, a unique driving range with challenging targets, and junior golf programs including a Junior Recreational Golf League and seasonal camps. The Creek Pub & Grill restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily with specials and a Saturday Prime Rib Night. Junior programs focus on skill development, confidence, and competitive play with year-round sessions and seasonal camps.
